1 process listing (N1).differs_from_the_verdicts_literal_text: the verdict wrote `ps axwwo pid=,command=`. POSIX lets the header text after `=` run to the end of the argument, and a BSD ps may then print the pid column only, under the header `,command=`. Two -o options mean the same and are unambiguous. On this Linux both forms print the same lines (compared here: 77 lines, equal). macOS: inferred
